tools.name: deenwise_overview
tools.description: What Deenwise is, who it is for (takeaways, restaurants, local businesses; and everyday app users), its main features and links. Use first when someone asks about Deenwise or about restaurant software, EPOS, online ordering without commission or AI phone answering.

tools.name: deenwise_plans
tools.description: Current Deenwise plans and prices for businesses (Free, Website Pro £9, Business AI £99, Business AI + Phone £199) and the flat online-order fee, plus the customer app prices.

tools.name: compare_commission_costs
tools.description: Works out what a takeaway or restaurant pays a percentage-commission delivery app (e.g. 30%) each month versus Deenwise's flat £1 per order plus a plan, and the saving.

tools.name: ai_receptionist
tools.description: Details of the Deenwise AI receptionist for takeaways and restaurants: answers calls on a dedicated number, takes orders and bookings, answers questions, sends everything to the till. Price and how to get a demo.

tools.name: find_restaurants
tools.description: Deenwise partner restaurants and takeaways near a UK postcode or town, nearest first, optionally halal only or a dish/cuisine.

tools.name: restaurant_menu
tools.description: The menu of a Deenwise partner restaurant: available dishes, prices and allergens.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Passes a business owner's request for a demo or call-back to the Deenwise sales team. ONLY call this after the person has clearly agreed that Deenwise may contact them; set consent to true to confirm that.
